headline: OpenAI buys Orchestra Bio to speed up drugs
dek: The startup joins Rosalind, which already serves Moderna and Novo Nordisk, OpenAI says.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: An acquisition with no price
body: OpenAI announced it bought Orchestra Bio, a startup that pairs people and AI agents to coordinate drug programs (OpenAI, TechCrunch).
Deal terms were not disclosed, according to OpenAI and TechCrunch.

points.t: Track studies and campaigns in a drug program.
See which timelines shift when something fails (OpenAI).
Weigh responses so the human team can decide.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Inside Rosalind
body: Orchestra joins Rosalind, OpenAI's set of AI models and tools for life sciences.
Rosalind already counts Moderna and Novo Nordisk as customers, according to OpenAI and TechCrunch.

stat.cap: raised before the deal, TechCrunch says

items.t: OpenAI wants AI across the whole life of a drug.
TechCrunch sees startups fearing big AI labs.
What OpenAI paid for Orchestra Bio was not disclosed.

caption.hook: OpenAI bought Orchestra Bio, a startup that coordinates drug development with AI agents.
body: According to OpenAI and TechCrunch, Orchestra joins Rosalind, OpenAI's life sciences AI platform, which already counts Moderna and Novo Nordisk as customers. Deal terms were not disclosed.

OpenAI says the agents track studies and campaigns in a drug program so the human team can decide the next step. TechCrunch says the startup had raised about $20 million and sees the deal as a sign of big AI labs moving into specific industries.
